name: Valderrubio (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre, bearing a green tobacco plant.
history: Valderrubio adopted its arms and flag on 23 June 2006, ratified on 16 December 2014; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, green, with a yellow triangle at the hoist charged with a tobacco plant, the crop that gave the town its wealth.

features.role: triangle from the hoist to the centre
